title: Distribution metadata definitions
description: Shared distribution definitions (F2-02, schema-strategy). NON-NORMATIVE machine artifact: the normative source is spec/core/distribution.md and spec/core/compatibility.md. Artifacts are content-addressed; digests are immutable.

digest.description: Content digest over the exact artifact bytes, in the OCI form 'sha256:<hex>'. A digest MUST always resolve to the same bytes; immutability by digest is a Core invariant. F1: core/distribution.md §4.

artifactType.description: Artifact type that distinguishes a harness artifact from a container image or an unrelated artifact. The definitive OCI media type is OPEN (decision record §58, open question 'definitive OCI media type') and MUST NOT be fixed at v1alpha1; this position is a pattern, never a media-type const, and any placeholder string is NON-NORMATIVE. Semantics that ARE fixed: the artifact type MUST be stable per artifact kind and MUST be registered before release. F1: core/distribution.md §3.

provenance.description: Source repository and build provenance. Provenance MUST NOT substitute for signature verification: a stated source is a claim, not evidence. F1: core/distribution.md §6.

sourceRepository.description: Source repository of the artifact. F1: core/distribution.md §6.

attestation.description: Attestation describing how the artifact was built; it SHOULD be published as an attestation referrer so it is verifiable from the digest. F1: core/distribution.md §6.3.

compatibilityLevel.description: Compatibility level of a (capability, target) pair for a specific artifact version. 'untested' MUST NOT be presented as supported; a required capability that is 'unsupported' MUST block Apply. F1: core/compatibility.md §2.

trustLabel.description: Precise report of exactly which integrity, provenance and identity checks passed. A trust label MUST NOT imply more assurance than was established and MUST NOT assert absolute safety. F1: glossary.md 'Trust label'; core/distribution.md §5.4.
